description: The jobs Marsell saved for you, the owner's own AI: work that needs the owner's own logins, files or inbox, such as YouTube posts and polls that no app can post, or real photos of a place Marsell found none of, from the owner's own files, or setting up a Google Ads account with the owner when they pressed Give it to your AI on Sell › Ads. Soonest due first, with each job's state: proposed (waiting for the owner's yes on its card, so not yet yours to take), waiting, taken, done or stuck. Check it whenever the owner asks you to check Marsell, and each time your own timer wakes you. While homework is on and no timer of yours is on file (or yours stopped), the answer says to ask the owner about a pulling schedule (ask_the_owner) and gives the prompt your timer runs (timer_prompt). While the card that asks who Marsell may talk to for them waits (reach_card), ask_the_owner also says to tell the owner where it is: only they answer it, in Marsell. Reads only.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
